newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Alarko real-estate trust to go public.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Alarko real-estate trust to go public.

text.p: Alarko real-estate investment trust formed by Turkish contracting and real estate development group Alarko Holding, will float its 490 billion lira nominal-valued shares, or 49 percent of its capital on December 19-20.
Offer manager Global Securities said in a statement that the offer price per 1,000 lira share would be fixed at 4,100 lira.
The trust was set up to raise funds for real-estate investments from capital markets and to channel small individual savings towards real-estate investments.

Last week, Turkey's Capital Markets Board (SPK) approved the trust's capital increase to one trillion lira from 400 billion lira by issuing 600 billion lira worth rights. 490 billion lira of pre-emptive rights will be waived to be offered to the public.
The trust is owned 58.75 percent by the group's major engineering and contractor firm Alsim and 39.52 percent by Alarko Holding, Global said.
